entry is NOT a regression: it is a string that was ALWAYS there and that
this gate could never see. The RESPONSIBLE PLAY paragraph is 281 characters
of English rendering to all sixteen locales under a translated heading.

disqualified the moment it wrapped, and LABEL_SHAPE capped candidates at 140
characters, which is a label length rather than a paragraph length. Found by

locales and is escalated in FABLE_COMMS entry 042.
